capabilities: Save public Substack posts as Markdown notes with searchable frontmatter
Download and embed images, video, audio, podcast episodes, and transcripts
Save threaded comments as separate notes embedded at the end of the post
Track saved posts in a sidebar history and bulk update comments
Save posts from a browser bookmarklet or iOS Shortcut via obsidian:// links
extras: Detailed settings, the obsidian:// link format, and troubleshooting live in a separate user guide rather than the README. Media and comment saving are off by default and must be enabled in settings.
problem: Reading and archiving Substack posts keeps content and media outside the vault, with no way to search or query them alongside notes.
summary: Web clipper that saves public Substack posts into the vault as Markdown notes with images, podcast media, transcripts, and comments.
